scope: Tier 3 Step 7 fiscal, declarations and procurement-accountability slices. A source or route name records discovery only; ready requires a reviewed chat adapter and SQL recipe with equivalent semantics.

outcomes.question: Rank municipalities by commitments, expense obligations or arrears for a year
Show one municipality's fiscal profile with quarter, debt, commitments, obligations, arrears and evaluable criteria
outcomes.prerequisite: Add and review a canonical municipal_fiscal_by_obshtina(obshtina, year, quarter) serving function plus shared obshtina lookup; singular free-text questions must remain unresolved until then.

outcomes.question: Show one municipality's fiscal indicators over time
outcomes.prerequisite: Add a canonical municipal_fiscal_history(obshtina, from_year, to_year) function that preserves quarter and null observations.

outcomes.question: Rank municipalities by municipal debt stock
outcomes.prerequisite: Validate the debt_stock_eur basis and eligible-population denominator, then add debt as a reviewed ranking metric instead of treating it as a liability-flow synonym.

outcomes.question: Compare a budget plan with execution on the same accounting basis
outcomes.prerequisite: Publish and contract a canonical budget_variance(period, entity, basis) function with plan, execution, variance, currency and reporting-period columns.

outcomes.question: Compare budgeted personnel costs and positions over time
outcomes.prerequisite: Publish a canonical budget_personnel_series(entity, from_year, to_year) function with an explicit position/payroll basis and comparable periods.

outcomes.question: Break a ministry budget down by programme and plan/execution
outcomes.prerequisite: Contract the ministry/programme serving route as a stable SQL function with ministry identity, programme code, plan, execution and basis metadata.

outcomes.question: Inspect a municipality's revenue and expenditure detail
outcomes.prerequisite: Add a municipality-identity lookup and a canonical budget_municipality_detail(obshtina, year, basis) function; document municipal coverage.

outcomes.question: Inspect named municipal capital projects and their funding
outcomes.prerequisite: Normalize the partial municipal annex corpus behind a coverage-bearing budget_municipal_capital(obshtina, year) function.

outcomes.question: Trace a budget figure to a law article or annex
outcomes.prerequisite: Expose stable law/article/annex identifiers and quoted source links from a canonical budget_law_detail(year, document_id) function.

outcomes.question: Show a uniquely resolved public person's declared assets, debts and net value by year
Inspect one declaration by reporting year and filing type
outcomes.prerequisite: Add a declaration identifier lookup and reviewed declaration_detail(declaration_id) function carrying register year, covered year, filing type and provenance.

outcomes.question: List a person's declarations by year and filing type
outcomes.prerequisite: Add canonical person_declarations(person_slug) output that distinguishes annual, entry, exit and correction filings and explicit missing years.

outcomes.question: Break declared assets and liabilities down by kind and value basis
outcomes.prerequisite: Contract declaration_breakdown(declaration_id) with asset/liability class, declared value, converted value, currency and conversion basis.

outcomes.question: Distinguish property owned by the declarant from property only used or attributed through relatives
outcomes.prerequisite: Expose held_scope, ownership/use right and relative attribution in a reviewed declaration-asset serving function; preserve missing relationship labels.

outcomes.question: Compare entry, annual and exit declarations and explain accumulation gaps
outcomes.prerequisite: Define comparable event pairs and cohort denominators, then expose canonical functions that never infer unexplained wealth from unmatched filing periods.

outcomes.question: Show declared company stakes and attributed procurement relationships
outcomes.prerequisite: Contract direct versus relative stake attribution, company identity and unmatched relationships in one reviewed serving snapshot.

outcomes.question: Compare a mayor's declared income with the official salary basis
outcomes.prerequisite: Join a canonical mayor term/person identity to salary resolutions and declaration income; keep gross official salary, declared employment income and other income separate.

outcomes.question: Show ADFI procurement findings, source document and outcome
outcomes.prerequisite: Ingest finding-level ADFI inspection documents and outcomes with stable inspection, entity, contract, date and source-document identifiers.

outcomes.question: Compare the signed contract value with amendments and current value
outcomes.prerequisite: Publish a deduplicated contract_annexes(contract_id) function with signed base, dated amendments, reason, delta, current value and currency basis.

outcomes.question: List subcontractors and their declared roles or shares
outcomes.prerequisite: Complete and validate the subcontractor loader, then expose contract_subcontractors(contract_id) with party identity, role, amount/share and missingness.

outcomes.question: Show consortium carrier and member roles without double-counting value
outcomes.prerequisite: Expose a canonical contract_participants(contract_id) function that labels carrier/member roles and attributes the contract value once.

outcomes.question: Inspect a tender's notice, award, contract and source documents
outcomes.prerequisite: Normalize document lineage and stable official URLs behind tender_dossier(tender_id) and tender_documents(tender_id).

outcomes.question: Compare awarded, contracted, amended and actually executed or paid value
outcomes.prerequisite: Ingest dated acceptance/payment/execution records linked to canonical contract IDs; awarded or current contract value alone is not execution evidence.
